source_support: GTK+ 2.24 reference manual: GtkCellRenderer ypad is a renderer property; GtkTreeView vertical-separator is a read-only style property: https://ftp.ccp4.ac.uk/ccp4/7.0/unpacked/checkout/gtk%2B-2.24.23/docs/reference/gtk/html/GtkCellRenderer.html

GTK+ 2.24 reference manual: vertical-separator is read-only and controls vertical space between cells: https://ftp.ccp4.ac.uk/ccp4/7.0/unpacked/checkout/gtk%2B-2.24.23/docs/reference/gtk/html/GtkTreeView.html
row_height.decision: Keep zero theme-controlled cell separators and do not shrink the KDE-derived font. The remaining 4 px difference from the local Motif fixture depends on application-owned GtkCellRendererText ypad and cannot be corrected by the GTK2 theme RC tested here. This does not prove a 19 px SR10.4 VM metric.
